data_point: Tooling decisions controlled by an incumbent accountant or bookkeeper
run_when: Search results mention the company's accountant or CPA firm.

prompt.task: Decide whether an outside accountant or bookkeeper, not the founder, controls the company's finance tool choices.
prompt.definition: This lowers the score but never disqualifies. Almost never public; expect unknown.
yes_when: Public statement that their CPA firm runs their books and picks the tools
no_when: The founder says they chose their own tools

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.
